versions.changelog: Switch production ClawTip backend to Cloudflare Pages Functions endpoint for stable access.
Point JD ClawTip flow to Cloudflare Worker backend with KV order storage and automatic paid fulfillment.
Require ClawTip payStatus SUCCESS before fulfillment and document same-account payment failure handling.
Add official JD ClawTip order scripts, SM4 encrypted_data, MD5 indicator, and payStatus validation.
Update JD ClawTip payment instructions to use skill-version 1.0.4 after live payment testing and document configurable language sprint indicators.
Document JD ClawTip order-file payCredential validation for local A2A delivery and update the default language sprint price to 0.50 CNY.
Fix JD ClawTip A2A pay command to use skill-version 1.0.1 while preserving Alipay AI Pay HTTP 402 payment wrapper guidance.
Add production API wrapper for Alipay AI Pay HTTP 402 plus JD ClawTip A2A order metadata and demo order generation.
Initial release: adaptive multi-language sprint tutor with placement diagnostics, interest-based lesson planning, spaced review quizzes, and Alipay AI Pay Restful-wrapper guidance.
